thread:
tanvi: kickoff: controlled rollout tonight. order US -> EU -> APAC. window 19:15-22:00 PT. incremental plan 1% -> 4% -> 18% -> full. APAC on manual hold due to cooling window.
marcus: doing warm-pool and thermal sanity now. will shout if headroom drops.
jing: warm-pool snapshot: US free=202/300, EU free=72/120, APAC free=21/80. APAC HVAC maintenance at 02:20 local; keep manual.
ops-bot: capacity readout: us-west-2 free=202 total=300; eu-west-1 free=72 total=120; ap-northeast-1 free=21 total=80. cmd: `opsctl pool status --regions us,eu,apac`
tanvi: @deploy-bot start US canary 1% pinned to v1.2.3, fallback=v1.2.2-slot. enable prefix cache warmup for the canary.
deploy-bot: canary started id=cb-3087654321 region=us percent=1 version=v1.2.3 fallback=v1.2.2
marcus: enabling cache prefill: `curl -X POST /internal/cache/warm -d '{"canary":"cb-3087654321","regions":["us"]}'`
jing: 9m check: p95=203ms, error_rate=0.06%, gpu_util=69%  green to wait 11m then step.
ops-bot: thermal check: no throttles in US. EU nominal. APAC remains manual hold.
deploy-bot: gate: +11m stability window before stepping to 4% in US. next decision at +11m.
release-manager: prepping a short announcement to post after EU 1% kicks. will include rollback snippet and support contacts.
tanvi: rollback procedure (region-first): `redwoodctl rollout cancel cb-3087654321 && redwoodctl promote --version v1.2.2 --region us`
marcus: 20m mark: US at 4% stable, error_rate=0.13%, p95=228ms. EU queued for 1% but operator approval required. APAC stays manual.
jing: capacity update: US.free=196, EU.free=71, APAC.free=21. no immediate pressure.
release-manager: final: posting update to #announcements once EU 1% goes live. next sync +25m or on alert. :thumbsup:
